Uniqueness and game foundations · lean

Unique winning opening in positive three-row rectangles

For every n > 0, the three-row n-by-3 rectangle has exactly one legal non-poison target that is a losing position for the next player.

Lean verified (stated scope)

Verification applies only to the recorded source snapshot and check scope. Consult the coverage report for build and axiom-check details.

Scientific review

Review verdict: passed. Evidence and exact scope are linked above.

Hypotheses and scope

  • Only n > 0 remains in the final mathematical statement. All recurrence-model fields are discharged from the recursively defined actual game.

Formalization correspondence

gameF is built from the actual P-position encoding. game_encodes, game_complete and game_lower_blocked discharge the model rather than assume the desired uniqueness. actualWins_iff_wins connects its diagonal/second-cut opening representation to actual P-targets. uniqueActualWinningTarget_checked expands the exact quantified claim. The independent review checks the move-to-target correspondence and poison convention.

Verification evidence

This corrected source snapshot passed a new clean strict build, exhaustive serialized and elaborated declaration/axiom census, and five fresh Lean kernel replays. Exact source/type correspondence and unchanged logical declarations after the documented comment corrections were checked separately. Only the standard propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound axioms were observed. Module and compiler-declaration counts are not counts of independent mathematical theorems.
